library.description: A library with the tags, targets, README and @app/* path alias the workspace rules expect.

service-module.description: An engine service (type:service, runtime:node) in the uniform service shape.

adapter.description: A type:adapter library with a port implementation skeleton and, with --confine, a third-party confinement row.

ui-feature.description: A type:ui-feature library with a lazy route, a standalone component and an i18n scope.

eslint-rule.description: A project ESLint rule in tools/eslint-rules with its spec, registration, path scoping and self-test.

lint-rule.description: A broker lint rule (DC-56) in libs/shared/lint-rules with fixtures per broker version.

decoder.description: A framework decoder: header-registry entry, fixture folder and, for the builtin tier, a code skeleton.

semantics-cell.description: A code-derived semantics cell linked to a conformance id.

conformance-cell.description: A lab-cell stub in apps/conformance for a conformance id.

migration.description: The next numbered persistence migration, with its spec.
